name: estasofttechnologies/estasoft-enterprise-erpcrm-sync-engine
description: Estasoft Enterprise ERP/CRM Sync Engine: a WooCommerce plugin that keeps your store in step with your ERP, accounting system or CRM through a durable queue.

scripts-descriptions.lint: Run PHPCS with the WordPress Coding Standards.
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Fix what PHPCBF can fix automatically.
scripts-descriptions.lint:syntax: php -l on every file and a scan for code WordPress.org rejects.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the PHPUnit unit tests (no WordPress, no database).
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the integration tests (real WordPress and database; see tests/README.md).
scripts-descriptions.check: PHPCS, PHPStan and the unit tests.
scripts-descriptions.check:all: Everything that can run locally, with a list of what was skipped.
scripts-descriptions.build:zip: Build the production zip (bin/build-zip.sh; add --dry-run to only check the file list).
